swipeComponent.name: Swiper
swipeComponent.function:
component:GetVar("direction"):SetInt(1) component:GetVar("mode"):SetInt(1) component:GetVar("tSteps"):SetFloat(25.0) component:listenToTouches(element)
local first = element:parent():GetElement("leftBreedingEntry0")
local numItems = element("NumBreedable"):GetInt() local itemHeight = first:absH() + 14
if((numItems * itemHeight) > element:absH()) then component:setScrollSize((numItems*itemHeight) - element:absH()) else component:setScrollSize(0) end
swipeComponent.event: local offset = component:scrollOffset() local first = element:parent():GetElement("leftBreedingEntry0") if first then if ( first:getOrientationPosition().y ~= offset ) then first:setOrientationPosition( Vector2( first("xOffset"):GetInt(), offset ) ) end end

element.event: element("SelectedEntry"):SetString("") element("SelectedEntryID"):SetInt(0) element("NewSelectedEntry"):SetString("") element("NewSelectedEntryID"):SetInt(0) element("NumBreedable"):SetInt(0) element:DoStoredScript("populate")

local monsterIds = game.breedingVector() local numMonsters = monsterIds:size() local previous = nil local numBreedable = 0
for i=0,numMonsters-1 do --if(game.getLevelForIslandMonster(i) >= 4) then local breedingEntry = menu:addTemplateElement("template_breedingentry", ("leftBreedingEntry"..numBreedable), element)
breedingEntry("List"):SetString("LeftMonsterList") breedingEntry("MonsterID"):SetInt(monsterIds[i]) breedingEntry("EntryNum"):SetInt(numBreedable) breedingEntry("ListIndex"):SetInt(i)
if(previous == nil) then breedingEntry:setParent(element) breedingEntry:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(16,0,4, lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.TOP)) breedingEntry:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.TOP) else breedingEntry:setParent(previous) breedingEntry:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(0,14,0, lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.TOP)) breedingEntry:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.BOTTOM) end
previous = breedingEntry
numBreedable = numBreedable + 1
breedingEntry:init() breedingEntry:setPositionBroadcast(true) --end
end element("NumBreedable"):SetInt(numBreedable)

local oldEntryName = element("SelectedEntry"):GetString() local newEntryName = element("NewSelectedEntry"):GetString()
if((oldEntryName ~= "") and (oldEntryName ~= newEntryName)) then local oldEntry = element:parent():GetElement(oldEntryName) oldEntry["bg"]["GreySprite"]("visible"):SetInt(1) oldEntry["bg"]["RedSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) oldEntry["bg"]["YellowSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0) oldEntry["bg"]["GreenSprite"]("visible"):SetInt(0)
for i=0,game.monsterCount()-1 do local rightEntry = element:parent():GetElement("rightBreedingEntry"..i) if((game.monsterType(oldEntry("MonsterID"):GetInt()) == game.monsterType(rightEntry("MonsterID"):GetInt())) and (game.monsterLevel(rightEntry("MonsterID"):GetInt()) > 3)) then rightEntry:DoStoredScript("enableEntry") end end
end
element("SelectedEntry"):SetString(newEntryName)
if(oldEntryName ~= newEntryName) then local newEntry = element:parent():GetElement(newEntryName)
element("SelectedEntryID"):SetInt(newEntry("MonsterID"):GetInt())
for i=0,game.monsterCount()-1 do local rightEntry = element:parent():GetElement("rightBreedingEntry"..i) if(game.monsterType(newEntry("MonsterID"):GetInt()) == game.monsterType(rightEntry("MonsterID"):GetInt())) then rightEntry:DoStoredScript("disableEntry") end end
element:parent()["rightBreedingEntry"..newEntry("EntryNum"):GetInt()]:DoStoredScript("disableEntry")
if(oldEntryName ~= "") then local oldEntry = element:parent():GetElement(oldEntryName) element:parent()["rightBreedingEntry"..oldEntry("EntryNum"):GetInt()]:DoStoredScript("enableEntry") end end
element:parent():DoStoredScript("checkCompatibility")
